描述_EN: c.90:1 to 5-2011 nushu was used exclusively by women, and the name literally means ‘women’s writing’. the dialect is spoken in a region of jiangyong county in hunan province, china. radstone’s text, written upside-down across a series of book-like forms, reflects the clandestine nature of the script. made in london stoneware, hand-built from press-moulded slabs, painted with slip and grey stain museum no. sara radstone (born 1955) ‘nushu’ 2006 nushu is a script used to write a local dialect of chinese. it developed as a form of private communication, sometimes embroidered onto fabrics or written on fans.
